/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 MESSAGE('Error: '||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG));
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 MESSAGE(P_SERVER_MSG);
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 MESSAGE(P_SERVER_MSG);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

CURSOR FIRST_LEVEL(V_SYSOBJ_ID NUMBER) IS
 

select SYSOBJ_ID,SYS_TYPE ,SYS_OS_FILE_NAME ,SYS_OS_LOCATION, fun_module from sc_system_objects
 where SYSOBJ_ID in (
select DISTINCT FUN_MODULE from sc_system_objects 
 WHERE MAINSYSOBJ_ID IN ( select DISTINCT FUN_MODULE from

 AND FUN_MODULE IS NOT NULL

);
 
 
 
function getpath(V_SYSOBJ_ID NUMBER) return varchar2 IS
 CO NUMBER:=1;
 begin
 
 FOR I IN (select SYS_OS_LOCATION, LEVEL from SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS SC_OBJ start with SYSOBJ_ID =V_SYSOBJ_ID
 connect by prior 
 MAINSYSOBJ_ID=SYSOBJ_ID 
 ORDER BY level DESC) LOOP
 
 IF CO=2 THEN 
 return I.SYS_OS_LOCATION;
 END IF; 
 CO:=CO+1;
 END LOOP;
 -- RETURN NULL;
 -- EXCEPTION 
 -- WHEN OTHERS THEN
 --RETURN NULL;
 end;
 
 PROCEDURE CHK_VALID(SYS_OS_LOCATION VARCHAR2,SYS_OS_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2,TYPE_FILE NUMBER) 
 IS 
 V_SIZE_FILE PLS_INTEGER; 
 compare_file_size pls_integer;
 FOUND NUMBER;
 v_file_path varchar2(200):=null;
 BEGIN
 IF TYPE_FILE=6 THEN
 
 v_file_path:=SYS_OS_LOCATION||'\REP\'||SYS_OS_FILE_NAME||'.REP';
 
 
 ELSE
 v_file_path:=SYS_OS_LOCATION||'\FMX\'||SYS_OS_FILE_NAME||'.FMX';

 end if; 
 
 -- @ NABIL
 --SELECT FILE_SIZE INTO compare_file_size FROM FILES_VERSION 
 -- WHERE FILE_NAME=SYS_OS_FILE_NAME AND ROWNUM=1;
 
 
 IF compare_file_size != V_SIZE_FILE THEN
 
 IF length(v_msg|| v_file_path|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13))<4000 then
 v_msg:= v_msg|| v_file_path|| CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 END IF; 
 
 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
 NULL;
 END;

begin
 
 
 PUBLIC_PATH :=getpath(V_SYS_OBJ_ID);

 CHK_VALID(PUBLIC_PATH,SYS_OS_FILE_NAME,type_file );
 
 
 
for frst_level in first_level(V_SYS_OBJ_ID) loop

 PUBLIC_PATH :=getpath(FRST_LEVEL.SYSOBJ_ID);
 CHK_VALID(PUBLIC_PATH,FRST_LEVEL.SYS_OS_FILE_NAME,FRST_LEVEL.SYS_TYPE );
 END IF;
 
 end loop;
 
 if v_msg is not null then
 V_FLASH_ALERT := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(CHR(1000)||V_msg || CHR(10) ||CHR(13),'INFORMATION',2, 'الجهاز غير محدث بالشاشات التالية يرجى مراجعة قسم الدعم الفني للتحديث',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1400, 'r100g0b0',30);
 exit_form;
 end if;

 pointer number;
